name: Mintlify Index MCP server
summary: Retired by the vendor, and since 2026-10-27 the host no longer resolves. One public MCP endpoint Mintlify ran for every caller, across the documentation it hosted and the open web; measured keyless 2026-10-07, one tool, context. On 2026-10-17 12:08Z keyless initialize, tools/list and tools/call each answered 200 with one sentence instead of a result: "Mintlify Index has been discontinued and this MCP server no longer returns results." The changelog dates it October 16, 2026. index.mintlify.com is NXDOMAIN at two resolvers, so surfaces.mcp is null; the 2026-10-07 records are history.

payments.notes: No keyless request drew a 402 and no page read prices this server. The pricing page's "MCP server" row is the per-site search server; "Index MCP" is absent from that page, counted by program. The documented 10/s and 5,000/day per-IP limits are a rate limit, not a paywall, and are unmeasured.
